title: Random Loot Spawner
description: That lets you fill containers with believable, survival-style loot in one command.
body:
## Random Root — Advanced Survival Chest Loot for Purpur/Paper/Spigot

**Random Root** is a feature-rich loot generation plugin for modern Minecraft servers.  
It lets you fill containers with realistic survival-style loot, use multiple themed profiles, auto-generate loot in naturally spawned containers, and control everything from config or in-game commands/GUI.

### Key Features
- Manual loot fill for targeted containers
- Multiple themed profiles (`overworld`, `nether`, `village`, `mine`, `dungeon`, `end`, `desert`, `ocean`, `jungle`, `snow`)
- Adjustable chest fill percentage (`0–100%`)
- Guaranteed full containers at `100%` fill
- Random durability and optional enchantments
- Anti-spam balancing for tools/armor
- `/random` command for fully chaotic random loot
- Natural structure loot system (world-generated containers only, configurable)
- In-game GUI for natural-loot settings (`/sloot gui`)
- Russian-friendly command/message support
- Works on modern server cores (Purpur/Paper and compatible Bukkit-based environments)
